name: Kettle & Break Area
purpose: this area is for off-duty operatives.
concierge_blurb: A kettle, two armchairs, the slow ticking of a clock. The building's reminder that the crew is allowed to rest.
lessons_learned_for_next_agent: The break area is the first deliberately non-operational room on F47 - it has no daemon, no jsonl tail, no endpoint. Its 'liveness' is a constant: kettle is always warm, doors are always open, seats are always two. Future agents should resist the urge to wire it to a sensor or timer. The whole point of the room is that it does not change. Pair it conceptually with night_mode_panel (which DOES change with the local clock) - the break area is the constant; the night-mode panel is the rhythm around it.
